$comment: Accepted dependency advisories for the gate 11 audit (infra/security/src/audit.ts). Each entry names the advisory, the package it was accepted for, why, and the date by which it is reviewed again; an entry past its review_by date fails the audit until someone reviews it and moves the date. Remove an entry once the advisory no longer appears. The audit fails on any production advisory and on any critical advisory anywhere in the tree (malware advisories are critical).

advisories.reason: No patched release exists (vulnerable <=1.4.0). It comes with the Expo command line tool that builds and serves Compass; the Compass app bundle does not include @expo/cli. Accepted 2026-10-19 (A54, gate 11).

It comes with the Expo command line tool that builds and serves Compass (@expo/cli uses it for development code signing and the local HTTPS certificate); the Compass app bundle does not include @expo/cli, so no app, Edge Function or Compass build on a device runs it. The patched 1.4.1 was published 2026-10-27 and becomes eligible under ADR 0001's two-week rule on 2026-11-10; then add the override node-forge@<1.4.1 to 1.4.1 in pnpm-workspace.yaml, check that expo start and an EAS build still run, and remove these entries (RRR-242). Accepted 2026-10-31.

Reached only at build time: @sentry/bundler-plugins globs the build output to upload source maps, and @bacons/apple-targets (apps/compass) globs the iOS targets during prebuild. Neither passes an AbortSignal or takes a pattern from a person. The patched 14.0.2 was published 2026-10-27 and becomes eligible under ADR 0001's two-week rule on 2026-11-10; it is a major release over the 10.5.0 and 13.0.6 in the tree, so the override is checked against both consumers before these entries go (RRR-242). Accepted 2026-10-31.

advisories.path: packages/data > exceljs > archiver > archiver-utils > glob > minimatch
advisories.reason: No pattern a person supplies reaches it. exceljs 4.4.0 (packages/data's spreadsheet exports, canon/import's workbook reader) uses archiver only to append workbook parts while streaming (lib/stream/xlsx/workbook-writer.js) and never calls archiver's glob or directory, which is where archiver-utils and readdir-glob call minimatch. The other paths are build time: @sentry/bundler-plugins (source map upload) and @bacons/apple-targets (Compass prebuild). The patched 11.0.1 was published 2026-10-27 and becomes eligible under ADR 0001's two-week rule on 2026-11-10; it is a major release over the 3.1.5, 5.1.9, 9.0.9 and 10.2.6 in the tree, so the override is checked against each consumer before this entry goes (RRR-242). Accepted 2026-10-31.

No patched release exists (vulnerable >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1). html-to-text uses deepmerge only to combine its option objects (html-to-text.cjs: the defaults with the caller's options, and duplicate selector entries); the email HTML is parsed, never merged. Our one caller, packages/email/src/render.ts, renders plain text with fixed options ({ plainText: true }), so no attacker-controlled object reaches mergeObject(). Review when html-to-text or deepmerge ships a fix. Accepted 2026-10-28 (RRR-241, gate 11).
